We got a list of templates. The last entry (template_id 6195) looks like a SN2 substitution: Cl-aryl + amine -> aryl-amine (C-N bond formed, halide broken). That matches our SN2 step. Template_id 6195.

Now need amide formation template. Look at other entries: maybe template 805512? That seems to be amide formation? It shows O-C(=O)-C-N-C(=O)-... Not sure.

Template 195396 maybe is amide formation? It shows [C:2]-[NH;D2;+0:1]-[c:3]>>O=C(-O-C-c1...)-[N;H0;D3;+0:1](-[C:2])-[c:3] which is converting an aniline to an amide with a carboxylate? Might be.

But we can search specifically for amide formation: functional_groups_broken: "acid chloride"? Let's search again with broken "acyl chloride" and formed "amide". No results earlier. Maybe use broken "acid chloride" (same). Let's try search with broken "acyl chloride" and formed "amide". Already did. Could try broken "acyl chloride" only.
<thought>Search for templates that break an acyl chloride (functional group) regardless of formed groups, to find amide coupling templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
